en.summary: Fixes LSU pending-queue bookkeeping for partial-thread requests and multi-cycle request issuance.
why_it_counts: The patch modifies the core load-store RTL unit, not surrounding software or tests.
It changes completion, dependency, and tag-hold logic for LSU requests that can span multiple cycles.
The subject explicitly identifies a pending-queue bug in lsu_unit.
disqualifiers: Part of the diff also expands debug printing, but the queue-control changes are the real behavioral fix.
evidence: req_ready_all replaces sent_all_ready and now treats inactive threads via ~req_tmask as already complete.
The patch introduces is_req_start and changes req_dep_ready to allow continued request issue after the queue slot has already been acquired, even if mbuf_full becomes true later.
req_tag_hold is now explicitly used to hold the acquired tag across a multi-cycle request instead of relying on the previous bookkeeping.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This fix repairs bookkeeping for a load-store unit that can issue one logical memory operation over multiple cycles or over a subset of active lanes. The buggy form treated masked-off lanes as if they still needed to handshake, and it rechecked queue-slot availability even after a slot tag had already been acquired for the in-flight request. That can stall partial-lane requests indefinitely or break tag consistency across split issuance.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: multi-lane LSU completion tracking and pending-slot hold across split issue
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A memory operation has inactive lanes, duplicate-lane compression, or multi-cycle issuance while the pending queue is near full or changes fullness mid-request.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Require all lanes, including inactive ones, to be considered before request completion, and reapply queue-full blocking even after a pending slot has already been allocated to the current request.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: ignore inactive-lane completion and drop acquired-slot hold exemption
portability_notes: Map this to any vector or multi-lane LSU that tracks which lanes of a request have already fired and that allocates a queue slot or tag before all beats are sent.
The key fault is mismatched bookkeeping between logical request completion and physical lane activity.
If the target DUT is scalar but can split a request over beats, the same bug can be injected by rechecking queue fullness after tag allocation.
concrete_injection_steps: Build the all-lanes-ready condition from only ready and already-sent lanes, and do not treat masked-off lanes as already complete.
Make continued issuance depend on the pending queue still not being full, even after the current request has already acquired a queue entry or tag.
Do not preserve the acquired request tag across the remaining beats of a split issue, or make later beats depend on the live allocator output again.
Keep the response path unchanged so the fault manifests as stalls, wrong tag reuse, or incomplete request submission.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LSU request send-mask tracking, request dependency gating, and held pending-queue tag
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit treats inactive lanes as already complete in req_ready_all, adds is_req_start so queue-full only blocks the first beat of a request, and uses req_tag_hold to preserve the acquired queue tag across multi-cycle issue.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_lsu_unit, remove ~req_tmask from req_ready_all, restore the older dependency check that requires ~mbuf_full on every beat, and stop exempting later beats via is_req_start and req_tag_hold.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Partial-lane or split LSU requests can hang, stop after the first beat, reuse the wrong pending tag, or complete with missing lanes under queue pressure.
evidence_for_injection: The fixed code explicitly adds ~req_tmask to req_ready_all, which proves inactive lanes were previously mishandled in completion tracking.
The new is_req_start term in req_dep_ready shows that queue-full should only block initial slot acquisition, not later beats of the same request.
The held req_tag path and removed pending_tags bookkeeping indicate the bug involved preserving tag identity across multi-cycle issue.
notes: A minimal single-line reinjection is to remove ~req_tmask from req_ready_all.
For a stronger reproduction of the original bug class, also restore the old req_dep_ready behavior so mbuf_full blocks later beats after tag acquisition.

zh.summary: 该修复纠正了 LSU 在部分线程请求和多周期发射场景下的 pending queue 记账逻辑。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是核心 load-store RTL 单元，而不是外围软件或测试。
它改变了可以跨多个周期发射的 LSU 请求在完成判定、依赖门控和 tag 保持上的逻辑。
提交标题明确指出是 lsu_unit 的 pending queue bug。
disqualifiers: diff 中也扩展了调试打印，但真正的行为修复是队列控制逻辑。
evidence: req_ready_all 取代了 sent_all_ready，并且现在通过 ~req_tmask 把非激活线程视为已完成。
补丁引入 is_req_start，并修改 req_dep_ready，使得一旦当前请求已经拿到队列槽位，即使之后 mbuf_full 变为真，也允许继续发射剩余部分。
req_tag_hold 现在被明确用于跨多周期请求保持已分配的 tag，而不再依赖旧的记账方式。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该修复针对能够把一个逻辑内存操作分多周期、或只对部分活跃 lane 发射的 LSU 记账错误。缺陷版本把已屏蔽的 lane 也当作仍需握手的 lane 处理，并且即使当前请求已经获得了队列槽位 tag，后续周期仍会重新检查队列是否已满。这样会让部分 lane 请求无限停住，或者在分段发射时破坏 tag 一致性。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 多 lane LSU 的完成跟踪与分段发射期间的 pending 槽位保持
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一次内存操作包含非激活 lane、重复 lane 压缩，或者在 pending queue 接近满且中途 fullness 变化时需要多周期发射。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在请求完成判定中仍把非激活 lane 算进去，并且即使当前请求已经分配了 pending 槽位，后续周期仍重新施加 queue-full 阻塞。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 忽略 inactive-lane 已完成语义，并去掉已获取槽位后的继续发射豁免
portability_notes: 可映射到任何向量或多 lane LSU，只要它会跟踪哪些 lane 已经发射，并且会在所有 beat 发完之前先分配一个队列槽位或 tag。
关键缺陷是逻辑请求完成条件与物理 lane 活动之间的记账不一致。
如果目标 DUT 是标量但支持多 beat 请求，也可以通过“分配 tag 后仍重新检查 queue fullness”注入同类错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 把 all-lanes-ready 条件建立在 ready 与 already-sent lane 上，但不要把被 mask 掉的 lane 视为已完成。
让后续 beat 的继续发射仍然依赖 pending queue 当前不满，即使当前请求已经分配了队列项或 tag。
不要在 split issue 的剩余 beat 上保持已获取的请求 tag，或者让后续 beat 再次依赖实时分配器输出。
保持响应路径不变，让故障表现为停顿、错误 tag 重用或请求提交不完整。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LSU 中的请求发送掩码跟踪、请求依赖门控和 pending-queue tag 保持逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交在 req_ready_all 中把非激活 lane 视为已完成，加入 is_req_start 使 queue-full 只阻塞请求首拍，并用 req_tag_hold 在多周期发射期间保持已获取的 queue tag。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_lsu_unit 中，从 req_ready_all 去掉 ~req_tmask，恢复旧的依赖检查使每个 beat 都要求 ~mbuf_full，并通过移除 is_req_start 和 req_tag_hold 的豁免来阻断后续 beat。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 部分 lane 或分段 LSU 请求可能挂住、只发出首拍、错误复用 pending tag，或者在队列压力下以缺失 lane 的形式错误完成。
evidence_for_injection: 修复后的代码显式在 req_ready_all 中加入了 ~req_tmask，这直接证明先前对 inactive lane 的完成跟踪是错误的。
req_dep_ready 中新增的 is_req_start 说明 queue-full 只应阻塞首拍获取槽位，而不应阻塞同一请求后续 beat。
显式保留 req_tag 的路径以及删除旧 pending_tags 记账，说明缺陷与多周期发射期间 tag 身份保持有关。
notes: 最小的单行回注方式是从 req_ready_all 中删除 ~req_tmask。
如果要更强地重现原始缺陷类别，还应恢复旧的 req_dep_ready 行为，使得在拿到 tag 之后，mbuf_full 仍会阻塞后续 beat。
